decisions.reason: The spring-controlled flap weir builds directly on the firm's core knowledge of weirs and hydraulic steel structures, so it can read early market feedback and improve the product in-house.

The energy management system serves the firm's familiar water-facility customers, but its digital, software-based nature resembles the dropped fouling-detection and web-tool products, so the risk is moderate. Its link to the core business still justifies keeping it for now.
The overflow flap gate is a core hydraulic engineering product that sits squarely within the firm's existing knowledge, and its dedicated web page signals strong commitment.
